title: What's New: Marketing Text Suggestions (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and announcement of GA status
Demo tour and marketing text feature overview
Edit dialogue features and user experience feedback
Deployment timeline, language support, and assessment process
User feedback mechanisms and feature toggles
Summary, developer resources, and call to action

features.name: Marketing Text Suggestions
features.description: An AI-powered copilot capability that generates product descriptions automatically using item attributes. Users can customize the suggestions by selecting specific attributes, tone, format, and emphasis before generation.
features.status_evidence_quote: marketing Tech suggestions is no longer in preview it is now generally available
caveats: Available only for Business Central online (SaaS), not on-premises
Available in eight languages only: English, Spanish, Dutch, German, Italian, French, Danish, and Japanese
Requires specific feature toggles to be enabled
Requires data movement consent if AI is not available in user's region

features.name: Fact Box UI for Marketing Text
features.description: A UI control in the item page where users can draft marketing text with copilot. In GA, the preview label has been removed and the interface now matches the standard copilot look and feel across Microsoft products.

features.name: Prompt Customization for Marketing Text
features.description: Users can edit the prompt to customize which item attributes to include, select tone (e.g., inspirational), format (tagline and paragraph), and emphasize specific aspects like sustainability before generating text suggestions.

features.name: Marketing Text Regeneration and Versioning
features.description: Users can generate multiple suggestions and keep the old ones visible for comparison. They can choose to keep a suggestion, discard it, or regenerate with the same parameters. Users can provide feedback with likes or dislikes.

features.name: Edit Dialog for Manual Text Editing
features.description: A redesigned edit dialog where users can manually edit existing marketing text without copilot assistance, or optionally draft new text with copilot that will replace the existing text after a confirmation warning.

features.name: Copilot Signature Look and Feel
features.description: Marketing text suggestions in GA now uses the standard copilot UI design consistent across all Microsoft products, with improved access to generative options and optimized workspace depending on the generation stage.

features.name: Language Support for Marketing Text Suggestions
features.description: Marketing text suggestions is available in eight languages: English, Spanish, Dutch, German, Italian, French, Danish, and Japanese, including localized variants. Users can switch to English even in localized environments.
caveats: In preview, only English was available
Extensive assessment process required before AI features are supported in new languages
More languages to be announced later

features.name: Feature Toggle in Feature Management
features.description: A feature key called 'Create AI powered product descriptions with co-pilot' in the feature management page controls the availability of the fact box and UI aspects of marketing text. Enabled by default for environments created in 2023 release Wave 1 (version 22) or above.
caveats: Does not control generative AI aspects
Requires manual enablement for upgrades from earlier versions

features.name: Copilot and AI Capabilities Page Toggle
features.description: A toggle on the new 'Copilot and AI capabilities' page (available only in Business Central online) enables the generative capabilities of marketing text. Enabled by default but requires user language support.
caveats: Only available in Business Central online
Replaces the previous copilot information page from preview
Requires user language to be supported

features.name: Data Movement Consent for AI
features.description: An optional toggle to allow data movement for AI processing if AI availability is not available in the user's region. Off by default and requires admin consent.
caveats: Required only if AI is not available in the user's region
Not required if AI is available in the region

features.name: Developer Tools for Copilot in Business Central
features.description: Marketing text suggestions has been rebuilt on new developer tools for copilot, enabling partners to design and implement similar generative AI experiences for their own extensions.

features.name: Bank Account Reconciliation Assistance with Copilot
features.description: Another AI-powered capability in copilot for Business Central that provides assistance with bank account reconciliation.
